name: Institution ownership or control passes to opaque parties followed by a volume surge
description: A bank, payment firm or other regulated entity changes owners, directors or key managers to parties whose backing is unclear, and soon afterwards shows sharply higher volumes, new customer types or new corridors.
fp: Genuine acquisitions, recapitalisations and expansion strategies change ownership and volumes together. Verify the new owners' source of wealth and business plan.

links.name: Institution ownership or control passes to opaque parties followed by a volume surge
links.ctx: Marks the point at which a previously sound institution may have been taken over to serve criminal flows.
